description: Renovate defaults for the zelesny org's repos. A repo takes them by adding "github>zelesny/.github" to its extends.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the cooldown: the exposure window is the bigger risk than a bad patch.

lockFileMaintenance.description: A lockfile refresh carries no release dates, so Renovate can't age-check what it pulls in and its stability-days check just sits pending. The package manager has to hold new versions back itself (uv: exclude-newer in pyproject); enable lockFileMaintenance only in a repo that sets one.
